verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say Agent Mode can be asked to add tests to requests and to update tests using natural language, which is the core of the story. Postbot is also documented as an AI add-on, with free usage capped at 50 activities per user per month. The evidence is limited to short one-line mentions and does not show tests being derived from an API spec or from captured responses. missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating tests or assertions from an OpenAPI spec or from response data, in-depth docs on the test-generation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated tests are good, clarity on how usage limits affect bulk generation.
